highlights_headline: This upcoming release adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel reads, and closes several native memory-safety issues.
highlights_body: New Graphite bindings bring Skia's next-generation rendering engine to .NET for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. Multiple native use-after-free bugs and a pixel-buffer leak are fixed. Hot-path allocations are reduced across SKData, GetEncodedText, and the uniform uniform-map. WASM gains .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6.

bullets.detail: Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs applied, including upstream stability improvements and cgmanifest updates.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: Full C# bindings for Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering backend are now available, enabling hardware-accelerated rendering via Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn on supported platforms.

bullets.lead: Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels for SKImage and SKSurface
bullets.detail: A new async pixel-read API lets callers request pixel data from any GPU backend without stalling the GPU pipeline.
A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET convenience package wires up Silk.NET Vulkan interop so consumers can create a GRContext with minimal boilerplate.

bullets.lead: Containerized test targets: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, and these targets are included in the shipped native asset set.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed
bullets.detail: The pixel-source SKBitmap or SKData could be collected before the derived SKPixmap finished using it; the root object is now kept alive for the lifetime of the pixmap.
The parent SKRegion could be garbage-collected mid-iteration; it is now rooted for the iterator's lifetime.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed
bullets.detail: When native raster image creation failed, the unmanaged pixel buffer was not freed; the leak is now closed.

bullets.lead: Binding generation is now deterministic across platforms
bullets.detail: The P/Invoke binding generator produces bit-identical output regardless of the build machine OS, eliminating spurious diffs in generated files.
SKData.SaveTo previously copied data into an intermediate buffer before writing; it now writes directly, halving peak memory use for large payloads.
HandleDictionary skip-registration check is cached; the null-terminated GetEncodedText path no longer allocates an intermediate string; SKRuntimeEffectUniforms map is pre-sized.
New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries with the new exnref exception-handling ABI are included, enabling SkiaSharp on .NET 11 WASM.

bullets.lead: Windows native build MSVC environment initialized once
bullets.detail: The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once per native build invocation instead of per-target, reducing build time on Windows.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support for Windows Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, giving text-layout workloads a working font engine on that platform.
